subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should maintainers publish a corrected stable package for the `v2026.6.11` reply-session dist/source divergence now, or wait for the next stable train while marking the release affected?
rationale: The remaining work is release/package handling and stable-channel risk ownership; the source fix is already on main, and repository policy requires explicit release approval for publish/version changes.

options.title: Ship Corrected Stable Package
options.body: Publish a stable package containing the current session-store fixes and verify the tarball dist before closing this issue.

options.title: Mark Affected And Wait
options.body: Document `v2026.6.11` as affected and leave this issue open until the next stable release carries the fixed dist.

options.title: Close Only After Beta Proof
options.body: Use beta proof to reduce risk but keep this stable issue open until `latest` is no longer the affected package.

recommendation.title: Ship Corrected Stable Package
recommendation.body: Publish a stable package containing the current session-store fixes and verify the tarball dist before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The history signal closest to the unresolved work is the `v2026.6.11` release tag/commit, while source-side owners are already identified for implementation details.
